requiredEnvironment: Windows x64/XAMPP, PHP >=8.2, supported MariaDB, PowerShell 5.1+, isolated test database and private backup directory

steps.action: Disconnect external network; run package verification, Python imports and technical acceptance; open all page families and document tools.
Use an empty portal namespace, install once, sign in, verify zero people/users except administrator; repeat installation must refuse; original legacy tables remain unchanged.
Administrator/personnel/direct URL/export, personal and inherited policy, permission removal during an existing session, last administrator protection.
Index, infaz natural ordering, first interview save/filter/reopen, DS0/1/2/3 and 14:00 transfer boundary, one/multiple page print.
Create draft, preview/publish, grant intended personnel only, create/edit/export a record, stale revision rejection and hidden fields.
100-node hierarchy, pan/zoom, narrow viewport, sibling order, cycle/stale update rejection.

10,000 synthetic people/100,000 module records/10 clients; 20 warm and 10 cold samples including sign-in; data p95 <=500 ms, usable p95 <=1s, initial shell <=300ms target; record server hardware and LAN.

Stop writing tasks, enter maintenance, create verified backup, restore ONLY into a new cte_next_restore_* schema and empty private directory; verify row content hashes, files and APP_KEY; source unchanged.
Prepare separate release; backup failure must block migration; keep APP_KEY and all data; prove code rollback compatibility without schema downgrade or data overwrite.
Admin-only health, safe route metrics/error count, failed backup status, successful/failed cleanup task reporting and scheduled task manual trigger.
Institution operator records date/environment/evidence and actual approval. Passing technical commands alone never signs off institutional acceptance.

cutover: Only after all evidence and operator signoff: change Apache DocumentRoot to chosen public directory, restart Apache, smoke-test, artisan up.
